Samuel Zweifel has responded that it will be used for European Horizon project Wildcard (correcspondence folder 0.4) which analysises the impact of rewilding (ie the abandonment of agricultural and forest management(), AND to assess the potential for additional rewilding across europe for climate mitigation. They will use the models EFIISCEN-Space and ForClim to make model based predictions of the additional carbon that could be sequestered through rewilding under future climate scenarios across eruope. They are using 16 Europeans countries data. It has been confirmed the data we have provided will be used exclusively for the context of the wildcard project. All simulation results will be aggregated per country or ecoregion to ensure plot locations remain confidential. Data will be used by them and team at Wageningen (they do the EFISCEN - Space model). Offered co-authorship with oportunity to comment on any resulting manuscripts. Chloe M would like to see manuscripts before publication anyway.
